exact: modulation by organism of host apoptotic programmed cell death
modulation by symbiont of host apoptotic process
narrow: modulation by symbiont of host apoptosis
modulation by virus of host apoptosis
regulation by virus of host apoptosis

definition: A process in which a symbiont gene product affects host apoptosis, leading to a change in the frequency, rate or extent of apoptosis in the host cell. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction.
label: Apoptosis modulation
